From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@averysys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Locking time for ML Infra design lab + attendee checklist

Hi Alex — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and suggested next step so we can get the engineering deep dive on the calendar.

Recap (from discovery)
- Primary objective: validate inference latency & cost tradeoffs for the 20–30 QPS peak workload, and agree on model/quantization strategy for production.
- Must-haves from your side: one infra lead, one ML engineer, and the product owner (to confirm APIs and data flow).
- Constraints: data retention audit requirement; your legal team will want SOC2 paperwork in advance.

Proposed next step
- 75-minute ML Infra design lab (remote): 60–90 minutes with ops + ML deep-dive and runbook checklist.
- Goals for session: workload profile, acceptable latency envelope, demo of prefix caching & batching, and a mutual action plan.

Slots we have available (PST):
- Tue 9 Jun — 10:00–11:15
- Wed 10 Jun — 13:00–14:15
- Thu 11 Jun — 08:30–09:45

Agenda (draft) — attached: redwood-mlinfra-agenda-v1.pdf
1) 10 min: goals & success metrics (your PO + Redwood AE)
2) 25 min: infra & data constraints (your infra lead + Redwood infra eng)
3) 20 min: technical demo (model variants, batching, caching)
4) 15 min: rollout & mutual action plan + next steps
5) 5 min: questions / blockers

Before the session, can you confirm:
- Which slot works (or propose two alternatives)?
- Who will be the attendee roster (name + role) so we can align the runbook? Please include emails.
- Any specific datasets/endpoints you want us to exercise during the runbook?

I've copied Ben (ops) and Connor (serving runtime lead) to confirm engineer availability and Marissa for customer success follow-through. Attaching the agenda draft and a stub with a mutual-action-plan link.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

One ask: can Ben or Connor include a short slide (5–7 min) about fallback policies & routing (we have multi-region constraints)? That will help us assess the operational tradeoffs.

I'll mark the Wed slot provisional and Lena will follow up if procurement needs to formalize a calendar invite with a SOW placeholder.

Best,
